title: PACK MACHINE #1 — conveyor line (PLC / drive / motor / belt / 4 sensors / palletizing robot)
description: Machine-twin #1 for Vidge Plant Management: a minimalist AND realistic conveyoring line. Lineage: spec.md §58 (PLC01 -Drive12> Motor42 -Pump17) generalized to machine-agnostic entity types (PLC, Drive, Motor, Conveyor, Sensor, Robot). Loaded by scripts/pack_load.py over line-delimited JSON-RPC 2.0 (vidgedb --service), read back with VidgeQL.

notes.props_cap: EMOT01 props are EXACTLY at the Phase-2 inline cap: 'spec.current.max=3' (19B) + 'spec.temperature.max=60' (24B) = 43B <= 44B (stores.rs ENTITY_CELL-20). '3' not '3.0' would push it to 45B and fail — the byte budget is part of the pack story (docs/pack-conveyor.md).
notes.units: spec.<signal>.unit props of these two signals would exceed the cap, so units (A, C, mm/s) live in the specs table + sensors_signals here and in the pack doc.
notes.series_owner: EMOT01.current / EMOT01.temperature land on the MOTOR (drive readback + PT100 via the drive over profinet) so that 'CHECK EMOT01.current' and diagnose(EMOT01) work as mandated. Vibration keeps its own sensor-local series SEN03.vibration with its spec prop on SEN03.
notes.determinism: Every scenario samples 500 points per series at dt=7 s over the hour grid [ts_start, ts_start+3493]. Seeds derive from (scenario_index*100 + series_index); waypoint noise seeds from the same formula, so loader runs are reproducible bit-for-bit.
notes.shapes: wave = base + amp*sin + noise (clamped) for healthy regimes; waypoints = piecewise-linear story (frac, value) for jam/overheat/fault profiles; pulse = piece-cadence square wave.
notes.events: log_event details are truncated by statestore.rs DETAILS_INLINE_MAX=20B; all message templates stay <=20 bytes. Alarm events are COMPUTED by the loader from threshold crossings of the generated points (rise/clear), provenance Event=5 — never hand-written into the JSON.

entities.name: PLC01
entities.doc: Line controller. Owns both network:profinet links (drive telegram + robot control).

entities.name: DRIV01
entities.doc: Variable-frequency drive. Electrically feeds EMOT01; current + speed readbacks surface over profinet.

entities.name: EMOT01
entities.doc: 1.5 kW 3-phase induction motor, 1500 rpm, 2.9 A nominal. Spec max current = 2.9 A x 1.05 margin rounded to 3.0 A; max PT100 temperature 60 C at 40 C ambient. 43B props (at the cap).

entities.name: CONV01
entities.doc: Conveyor section 1: mechanical M/M construction, PU belt, 3.5 m, speed range 0.2-0.5 m/s.

entities.name: SEN01
entities.doc: Photoelectric piece-presence sensor at belt start, 24 V discrete.

entities.name: SEN03
entities.doc: Motor-case vibration sensor, 4-20 mA loop scaled to mm/s RMS. ISO 10816-3 zone A/B boundary 2.5 mm/s for small machines. Carries its own spec prop (the motor props block is full).

entities.name: SEN04
entities.doc: PT100 motor temperature probe wired into the drive (G120 analog input); value surfaces as EMOT01.temperature over profinet.

entities.name: ROB01
entities.doc: 6-axis palletizing robot (KUKA/ABB class), 12 kg payload, at the line end: takes pieces off CONV01 toward the packing zone. Controlled by PLC01.

specs.note: Nominal 2.9 A x 1.05 service margin, rounded to 3.0 A (IEC 60034 duty S1). Stored as the entity prop spec.current.max=3 (the value the CHECK engine reads; unit would exceed the 44B props cap, kept here + in the doc).
PT100 motor-body limit: class F winding with B temperature-rise budget at 40 C ambient. Stored as spec.temperature.max=60 (unit dropped for the cap).
ISO 10816-3 / ISO 20816-3 zone A to B boundary for small machines (< 15 kW), RMS.

sensors_signals.kind: photoelectric, 24 V discrete, one pulse per piece
accelerometer, 4-20 mA loop scaled to mm/s RMS at the sensor (series stays sensor-local)
PT100 wired into the DRIV01 analog input; value lands on the motor series over profinet
drive phase-current readback (RMS) over profinet; lands on the motor series

demo_scenarios.name: normal
demo_scenarios.description: Healthy hour: 2.5-2.9 A, < 2 mm/s vibration, 40-55 C, regular piece cadence (one piece per 30 s, all metal). Every check OK, zero alarm events.

demo_scenarios.name: overload
demo_scenarios.description: Stick-slip jam hour: rollers seize — the drive current oscillates in the 3.2-4.1 A band (peaks vs spec 3.0 A => CHECK VIOLATION), with brief recoveries to ~2.8-2.9 A between stick episodes; vibration 2.4-3.5 mm/s (spec 2.5 => VIOLATION); belt speed sags to ~0.35 m/s; temperature climbs to 58 C but stays under its 60 C limit (OK). Threshold crossings are logged as alarm_current_max(+/clear) and alarm_vibration_max(+/clear) events, provenance Event.

demo_scenarios.name: overheating
demo_scenarios.description: Cooling-fault hour: the cabinet fan fails (cooling_fault event at +60 s) — the motor body climbs from 52 C past the 60 C limit (~+590 s, alarm_temperature_max rise logged), keeps 65-80 C (peaks 80.0 C vs spec 60 => CHECK VIOLATION), the drive trips thermally at ~+3248 s (thermal_trip event, EMOT01.state=TRIPPED_THERMAL, belt stops), and the body cools back under 60 C (alarm clear logged) while current stays nominal before the trip (2.6-2.9 A => OK) and vibration stays < 2.5 mm/s (OK).
